name: game-bot-control
title: Game Bot Control
author: awm
description: Per-seat control of server-held drone bodies over RCON: a drone character that collides with nothing and reaches 128 tiles, a seat registry keyed by seat name, straight-line movement, real (engine-driven) mining, the real crafting queue with crafts counted in production stats, build/insert/take/throw, cheat-flagged research, a drainable events buffer, and a tool registry of named, persistent call and lib tools. State lives in `storage` so seats survive save/load.
